scripts.artifact:build: bun run client:build && bun run build-artifact.ts
scripts.build: bun run artifact:build && bun ../../scripts/deployment-config.ts hosted && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c ../../.deployment/hosted/app/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist/gateway
scripts.test: bun test src && bun run test:workerd
scripts.test:integration: bun run artifact:build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.access.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
